title: Working with arrays
hints: word_counts: split with preg_split('/\s+/', strtolower(trim($text)), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY), count with ??, then ksort($counts).
top_scorers: take array_keys($scores), sort the names with usort comparing the scores, then array_slice($names, 0, $limit).
only_adults: array_filter keeps the original keys. Wrap the result in array_values to get keys 0, 1, 2.
